observations.body: A third visit invokes witnesses and crucified weakness. This is the third time I am coming to you. “At the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.” For he was crucified through weakness, yet he lives through the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we will live with him through the power of God toward you.

payload.posture: Read 2 Corinthians 13:1–4 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states a third visit invokes witnesses and crucified weakness. This is the third time I am coming to you. “At the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.” For he was crucified through weakness, yet he lives through the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we will live with him through the power of God toward you. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
